sentences: VOP3 `op_sel:[s0,s1]` selects bit `[15:0]` (`0`) or `[31:16]` (`1`) of each source before f16 input modifiers (`neg`/`abs`, via `Gen.f16_in`) or `u16`/`i16` zero-/sign-extension (`OpBitFieldUExtract`/`OpBitFieldSExtract` at bit offset 16 when set, 0 otherwise); VOPC writes a scalar lane mask (VCC/SGPR or EXEC for `v_cmpx`), so there is no destination `op_sel` bit.
Until 2026-11-22 `Gen.compare` hardcoded the low half and ignored `mods`.
Source: AMD RDNA2 ISA VOP3 `op_sel` and Mesa ACO `can_use_opsel`.

**Measured natively on RDNA2** (gfx1036, AMD Ryzen 7000 iGPU, driver 26.11.2) across wave32 and wave64: `v_cmp` writes 0 for inactive lanes in `sdst` (`s4` in wave32, `s[4:5]` in wave64); `v_cmpx` kills inactive lanes in EXEC; inline float constants (`1.0`, `-2.0`, `0.5`, `4.0`) read f16 in low half with `op_sel=0` and +0.0 with `op_sel=1`; inline integer constants (`1`, `-1`) read low half with `op_sel=0` and high half with `op_sel=1` (`0` for `1`, `0xFFFF` for `-1`); 32-bit literals read `[15:0]` (`op_sel=0`) and `[31:16]` (`op_sel=1`, including signed negative high halves in `i16`); SGPR high halves as src0 and src1 with modifiers (`neg`, `abs`); and f16 ordered vs unordered relations on `qNaN`/`sNaN`.

Probed natively with zero divergences by `tools/probe_gfx1036_vcmp16.py`, and checked on the CPU by `tests/semantic/test_vcmp16_opsel.py` (all four `op_sel` combinations, spirv-val compliance, wave32/wave64 EXEC updates and inactive-lane 0 writes in `sdst`).

Checked on the CPU by `tests/semantic/test_vcmp16_opsel.py` (all four `op_sel` combinations across `f16` relations/ordered/unordered/NaN/`neg`/`abs`, `u16`, signed `i16`, and `v_cmpx` wave32/wave64 EXEC updates via `spirv_mini_interp` and `spirv_wave_interp`); **not GPU-verified**.
